run_vocab_intersection: run the vocab intersection script to compute common vocabulary across cased and lowercased language models
run_cased_vocab_intersection: run the vocab intersection for cased models like BERT cased and ELMo and save results to a file
run_lowercased_vocab_intersection: run the vocab intersection for lowercased models like BERT uncased and OpenAI GPT
review_vocab_intersection_function: review the __vocab_intersection function that computes common vocabulary across multiple pre-trained language models
refactor_vocab_intersection: refactor the __vocab_intersection function to support additional language model types or custom vocabulary filtering
